description: About the Team: Global Supply Chain is at the heart of GSK, manufacturing and supplying reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to patients around the world while driving our performance as a business. It establishes one integrated view of approved priorities, milestones, dependencies, capacity, funding, forecasts, risks and decisions, and coordinates delivery and service-readiness dependencies across product supply, partner onboarding, packaging, artwork, labelling, pack data, quality, enterprise platforms and external partners. The role supports resilient operations, effective partner collaboration and simpler operations through standardization, automation and responsible use of AI. It maintains security, quality, Gapp and regulatory controls where applicable, with clear human accountability for decisions affecting product quality, continuity of supply and regulated packaging, artwork and labelling processes. Key Responsibilities: Own the coordinated transition of approved new and changed technology capabilities into stable, supportable and compliant live services for assigned External Manufacturing and Digital Pack products, services and cross-functional initiatives, from integrated delivery planning through deployment, handover and early-life support. Accountable Product and Technology leads retain ownership of strategy, roadmap, scope, solution direction, adoption outcomes and value realisation. Own integrated delivery governance for the portfolio through agreed plans, governance forums and decision controls covering approved priorities, milestones, entry and exit criteria, critical paths, dependencies, capacity, resources, risks, issues and decisions across business teams, GSK technology groups, contract manufacturers, packaging partners and strategic suppliers. The accountable Product or Technology lead retains accountability for External Manufacturing strategy, transformation priorities and end-to-end programme outcomes. Provide service leadership for portfolio products and integrations, ensuring stability, availability, continuity, performance and effective support for manufacturing, packaging, artwork, labelling and pack-data operations. Act as the senior escalation point for delivery and operational issues, coordinating rapid recovery and clear decisions where incidents or delays could affect product supply, manufacturing partners, packaging operations or market launch readiness. The accountable Product or Technology lead retains ownership of business readiness, adoption and value outcomes. Own portfolio financial governance, including annual planning, budget and forecast management, actuals tracking, resource and supplier cost oversight, variance analysis, financial risks and corrective actions, ensuring investment remains aligned to agreed priorities and outcomes. Own benefits baselining and tracking governance across the portfolio. Agree documented baselines, measurable targets, data sources, review dates and a named accountable owner for each benefit with Product and Technology leads, business stakeholders and Finance before implementation. Track actual outcomes against baselines beyond initiative closure against the agreed measurement schedule, validate evidence with benefit owners and Finance, and escalate shortfalls with corrective actions. Feed measured results back into portfolio prioritisation. Accountable Product and Technology leads retain ownership of end-to-end value realisation. Maintain portfolio governance dashboards and decision materials covering delivery status, financial performance, service health, benefits, capacity, dependencies, technical debt, partner performance, risks, issues and decisions required. Partner with stakeholders to prioritise portfolio investments and delivery, resilience, obsolescence, compliance, data quality and integration risks within product and technology roadmaps. Manage technology suppliers and managed service partners against delivery commitments, contractual obligations, costs and service outcomes, retaining GSK accountability for critical and regulated decisions. Coach Product Owners and delivery leads on integrated planning, RAID (risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies) and operational readiness to strengthen delivery discipline at source. Build capability in financial and benefits governance, service transition and operational management. Own, maintain and continuously improve delivery and service standards, methods, controls and reusable practices across the portfolio, ensuring consistent adoption and measurable improvement. Lead continuous improvement through simplification, standardisation and automation, and use approved AI tools in the role’s own day-to-day work, including AI-assisted reporting, incident analysis and documentation. Check outputs for accuracy, evidence, confidentiality and compliance, retaining human accountability for decisions and final deliverables. Demonstrated experience delivering significant technology change while maintaining stable live services for supply chain, manufacturing, packaging, artwork, labelling or partner-facing operations. Strong experience leading portfolio delivery governance, including integrated planning, prioritisation, capacity and dependency management, governance forums, RAID control, executive reporting and decision tracking across multiple products and initiatives. Demonstrated expertise in service transition, ITSM practices, operational acceptance, major-incident leadership, root-cause investigation and sustainable remediation. title: Data Platform Engineer
description: Job Description Be part of something bigger. Decode the future. All about the role: As a Data Engineer at Electrolux Global Data & AI (GDAI) Team, you are the backbone of our digital supply chain for information - the person who turns raw, scattered data into reliable and trusted data and AI products. You will work across the full lifecycle of data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery, on our modern Lakehouse stack built on Azure Databricks. Like the Data Engineering teams at the world's largest tech companies, we hold a high bar: we hire builders who think like owners, dive deep into ambiguous problems, and are equally comfortable architecting a pipeline as they are explaining a metric to a business stakeholder. You will have broad exposure across ingestion, platform, modeling, and delivery, and you will help define the boundary between our Platform and Product Data Engineering functions as our data organization scales. What you’ll do: Data Ingestion & Integration: Design and build pipelines that reliably move data from a wide variety of source systems – relational databases, external sources and operational datastores - into our Lakehouse, merging disparate sources into a single, trustworthy picture for the business. Transformation & Modeling: Build and maintain ELT pipelines using dbt to transform raw data into clean, well-modeled, business-ready assets, applying dimensional modeling and consistent KPI definitions so the same metric never means two different things in two different dashboards. Platform Contribution: Operate and extend our Azure Databricks Lakehouse, contributing to schema design, query optimization, and scalable data processing so the platform scales reliably as data volume and complexity grow. Orchestration & Reliability: Own end-to-end pipeline orchestration in Airflow, building workflows that run in the right order, recover automatically from failure, and are observable through monitoring, alerting, and audit trails. Data Quality & Trust: Implement automated data quality checks and testing so that accuracy, completeness, and timeliness are verified continuously, not discovered by a business user staring at a broken dashboard. Data Mesh & Domain Ownership: Apply data mesh principles to design data products with clear ownership, discoverability, and contracts across domains, reducing tight coupling between teams and enabling other domains to self-serve trusted data. Automation & Engineering Rigor: Bring a software engineering mindset to Data Engineering - version-controlled code, CI/CD, code review, and Infrastructure as Code - so pipelines are tested, repeatable, and maintainable rather than one-off scripts. Cross-Functional Partnership: Work directly with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable data solutions and collaborate closely with the Platform and AI teams to align on shared infrastructure, standards, and roadmap, communicating trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Cost & Performance Ownership: Monitor and optimize computing and storage costs on Azure, treating cost efficiency as a first-class engineering concern rather than an afterthought. AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI pair-programming tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate development and build agentic CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions that automate testing, review, and deployment with minimal manual intervention. Who are you Proven Track Record: 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer building and operating production data pipelines at scale, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment like those found at leading tech companies. SQL & Python: Strong hands-on skills in SQL (query optimization, schema design) and Python for pipeline development and automation. Cloud & Lakehouse Experience: Practical experience with a cloud data platform (Azure strongly preferred) and modern Lakehouse or data warehouse architecture. Pipeline & Transformation Tooling: Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, ideally with dbt, and orchestrating them with a workflow manager such as Airflow. Ownership Mindset: A track record of taking ambiguous problems from first principles to a working, reliable solution, and a comfort level moving across ingestion, modeling, and delivery as the situation demands. Communication: Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and translate business requirements into scalable, well-modeled data assets. AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants in daily development, and building CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions. Technical Qualifications: Our data platform is built around a modern Lakehouse architecture. You will work with: Core Platform: Azure Databricks Lakehouse on Microsoft Azure. Transformation & Modeling: dbt (data build tool) for version-controlled, testable data modeling. Orchestration: Apache Airflow for workflow scheduling, dependency management, and recovery. Ingestion: Azure Data Factory and batch/streaming integration patterns. Languages: Python and SQL at a professional, production-grade level. Architecture: Data Mesh principles applied to domain-oriented data ownership and data products. Engineering Practices: GitHub and GitHub Actions for version control and CI/CD, agentic CI/CD workflows, and Infrastructure as Code. AI-Assisted Development: GitHub Copilot and similar AI pair-programming tools embedded in the daily workflow. This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Why work for Electrolux? Build at scale : Lead the development of mission-critical digital commerce experiences used by thousands of customers daily. Own the architecture : Influence core technical decisions and help evolve our platform for high scalability, resiliency, and flexibility. Modern tech stack : Work with cutting-edge tools in cloud, commerce, and full-stack engineering. Empowered leadership : Drive strategy and execution while mentoring a world-class engineering team. Growth and impact : Join a high-growth company with a culture that values engineering excellence, innovation, and transparent leadership. As part of the Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you!
